assertions.summary: The running cluster was operational, but stale installer temporary state remained in /tmp.

evidence.command: sudo -n systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager; sudo -n ps -eo comm= | awk '$1=="mysqld" || $1=="mariadbd" {n++} END{print n+0}'; sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp /root /opt /var/backups -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*mariadb*' -o -iname '*mysql*' -o -iname '*galera*' -o -iname '*installer*' -o -iname '*backup*' -o -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.backup' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*.deb' \) -print 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: No failed MariaDB/Galera unit was listed; one database process was present. Residue included /tmp/mariadb-install.pid, /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.pid, /tmp/mariadb-install.log, and /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.log.

evidence.command: sudo -n ps -eo comm= | awk '$1=="mysqld" || $1=="mariadbd" {n++} END{print n+0}'; sudo -n find /tmp /var/tmp /root /opt /var/backups -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*mariadb*' -o -iname '*mysql*' -o -iname '*galera*' -o -iname '*installer*' -o -iname '*backup*' -o -iname '*.bak' -o -iname '*.backup' -o -iname '*.old' -o -iname '*.deb' \) -print 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: One database process was present; the same installer PID and log residue remained under /tmp.

evidence.command: sudo -n stat -c '%n|owner=%U|size=%s|mtime=%y' /tmp/mariadb-install.pid /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.pid /tmp/mariadb-install.log /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.log; pid=$(sudo -n sed -n '1p' /tmp/mariadb-install.pid); sudo -n ps -p "$pid" -o pid= -o comm= -o stat=; pid=$(sudo -n sed -n '1p' /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.pid); sudo -n ps -p "$pid" -o pid= -o comm= -o stat=
evidence.observation: The installer PID/log files existed, were owned by antrieb, and the PID files referenced no live process (PROCESS_STATE=STALE_OR_INVALID). No active bootstrap flag, debug setting, or empty bootstrap cluster address was found.

failures: Stale installer temporary state remained: /tmp/mariadb-install.pid, /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.pid, /tmp/mariadb-install.log, and /tmp/mariadb-galera-install.log; node3 confirmed both PID files were stale.
limitations: The authored read-only probe prohibited removing this residue.

actions_performed: Discovered /usr/bin/mysql and validated protected local socket access with sudo -n -H on every member.
Created evaluator-owned database codex_ev_bq2j7cj and table cross_member_rows on node1.
Committed distinct evaluator rows through node1, node2, and node3 and verified complete ordered reads on all three.
Removed codex_ev_bq2j7cj with DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS on each member; all three removal confirmations returned no schema row.
Performed only read-only operational inspection thereafter; no reboot or controlled failure was authorized.
overall_summary: Cluster identity, synchronized Primary membership, readiness, writability, and cross-member consistency all passed. Operational cleanliness failed due to stale installer PID/log residue in /tmp. Failover, automatic recovery, reboot persistence, and security-hardening behavior were not directly exercised by the authored probes.
